description: Enhances AprilTag detection speed by preprocessing camera images with a position-based neural network to crop the input image to areas of interest (position and scale method)

model_path.description: Path to the trained position predictor model weights file

device_id.description: The id of the computation device for processing

conf_threshold.description: Confidence threshold for position predictions (0.0 to 1.0)

padding_factor.description: Factor to pad around detected positions (0.0 = no padding, 0.5 = 50% padding)
